source_artifacts: 24 derived-consequential-shard artifacts from the successful run

symmetry.carrier: S3 conjugation of input/output carrier labels
symmetry.argument_swap: No additional quotient required for capability sets: with both projections x and y available, a generated term-function set is closed under x/y renaming.
symmetry.canonicalization: Exact bitsets were transformed under all six carrier permutations; classes were grouped by the lexicographically minimal transformed bitset. For the reference-sensitive quotient, the with-ground and no-ground bitsets were transformed by the same permutation.

Q_capability_fixed_symmetry.interpretation: Exact quotient for the complete set of binary term-functions expressible from x,y,ground, modulo carrier relabeling.

Q_capability_plus_reference_symmetry.interpretation: Exact quotient preserving both the with-ground capability set and the no-ground capability set, modulo the same carrier relabeling.

claim_boundary: Finite exact census only. These are capability-set quotients, not contextual equivalence classes for a language that exposes the original primitive operation as a named observable. The 747-class quotient forgets ground-dependence provenance; the 1091-class quotient preserves it.
